About us

Nasaeem Libya for Importing Perfumes and Cleaning Materials is a leading name in perfumes and cleaning products in Libya. Building on more than a quarter of a century of experience in the trade, across several business names, the company was founded in 2015 to become a standout name committed to the highest quality standards and the best products.

Our goals

To offer unique products and services that give us a competitive edge in the market:

  1. Earn the satisfaction and loyalty of our customers.
  2. Grow our business and expand into new markets.
  3. Keep developing new solutions and products that meet the market's expectations.
  4. Take an active part in social and environmental initiatives that support sustainability.
  5. Keep improving as a company and keep pace with the market.

Our services

  • 01Importing and distributing a wide range of luxury perfumes.
  • 02Supplying cleaning, body care and skin care products.
  • 03A complete network of distribution points across the country.
  • 04Planning local production of perfumes and cleaning materials.
  • 05Building long-term partnerships with suppliers and distributors alike.
  • 06And we keep our list of services open as we look to the future.
